gaps.explanation: Pass 8 (re-trim). New trimmed p22 (printed p172) is the Combining Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position - Nonmajor Enterprise Funds, columns Golf, Parking Systems, Pinnacle Bank Arena, Solid Waste Management, Emergency Medical Services, Broadband Enterprise, Total. Per the user's ruling the 21 combined 'Other Enterprise Funds' lines from the proprietary funds statement (p11, detail indexes 181-201) are replaced by one line per printed non-zero row per individual fund column (Total column, subtotals and blank cells not used), same pattern as Lincoln_FY2024/FY2023 pass 5; categories as on the FY2025 combined lines. Every row re-adds exactly to the combined amount: Charges for Services 498,987 + 2,381,138 + 19,490 + 12,478,232 + 118,948 = 15,496,795; Fees 6,730,839 + 1,383,761 + 11,767,934 = 19,882,534; Parking Revenue 11,479,646 (Parking Systems only); Performance Revenue 10,651,657 (Pinnacle Bank Arena only); Other Operating Revenue 60,648 + 219,901 + 1,702,670 + 1,080,281 + 7,246 = 3,070,746; Investment Earnings 140,421 + 186,017 + 360,399 + 662,407 + 332,113 + 95,342 = 1,776,699; Lease Income 1,335,823 and Lease Interest Income 354,532 (Broadband only); Grant Revenue (2,588) (Solid Waste only); Insurance Recoveries 4,311 + 7,882 + 17,925 = 30,118; Occupation Tax 5,985,901 (Solid Waste only). Revenue added 70,061,863 = removed 70,061,863 (indexes 181-191); each column's operating revenues re-add to its printed Total Operating Revenues (Golf 7,290,474, Parking 15,464,446, Arena 12,354,327, Solid Waste 12,867,705, EMS 12,485,478, Broadband 118,948). Governmental: new trimmed p16 (printed p125) is the summary Combining Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Nonmajor Governmental Funds (Special Revenue 77,532,707 / Debt Service 14,361,671 / Capital Projects 35,655,106 / Permanent 6,912,098 total revenues); these are column totals of the fund-by-fund combining statements pp17-21 already in detail (schedules 'Nonmajor Special Revenue / Debt Service / Capital Projects / Permanent Funds'), so nothing is added from p16.

gaps.explanation: p22 (printed p172), individual nonmajor enterprise fund columns replace the combined p11 'Other Enterprise Funds' expense lines (indexes 192-198). Rows re-add exactly: Personal Services 2,159,360 + 324,706 + 4,032,225 + 3,993,190 + 8,099,332 + 381,249 = 18,990,062; Contractual Services 262,244 + 5,094,569 + 6,027,417 + 6,012,063 + 568,622 + 76,885 = 18,041,800; Operation and Maintenance 2,439,244 + 3,356,519 + 2,973,634 + 4,148,817 + 1,293,368 + 311,995 = 14,523,577; Depreciation 427,931 + 2,563,796 + 186,090 + 3,047,655 + 337,471 + 2,059,118 = 8,622,061; Amortization 535,000 + 107,298 = 642,298; Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Capital Assets 875 + 16,000 + (2,160) + (168,825) + 5,872 = (148,238); Interest Expense and Fiscal Charges (37,008) + (1,007,419) + (150,345) + (22,960) = (1,217,732). As on the combined lines (loss 148,238 and interest 1,217,732 shown as positive expenses), the Gain (Loss) and interest cells are recorded in the expenditure section with the printed sign reversed: printed losses (2,160), (168,825) as +2,160, +168,825; printed gains 875, 16,000, 5,872 as -875, -16,000, -5,872 (net 148,238 = removed line). Each column's operating expenses re-add to its printed Total Operating Expenses (Golf 5,823,779, Parking 11,446,888, Arena 13,219,366, Solid Waste 17,201,725, EMS 10,298,793, Broadband 2,829,247). Expenditure added 62,185,768 = removed 62,185,768.
